source_set_format: sha256 two spaces relativepath newline, sorted by path; receipt and immutable revisions/ archives excluded
profile: Opt-in pddartsurvey=1, exact J293/T8103 normal dart-apcie0, raw T8020 register observation only

checks.sanitizers: ASan/UBSan; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1, UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1. Known host ptrace LSan restriction only.
checks.saved_ADT_guard: PASS using actual production board.c in a separate unsanitized ordinary host shared library
checks.native_Cpp: Full adapter source-shape only, no SDK compile. Actual publication body extracted verbatim and host-compiled C++14 with ASan/UBSan; 40 status/allocation/provider/instance combinations pass, retained copy survives instance destruction.
checks.reference_bytes: Five m1n1 references compared to exact local Git objects; two Linux files matched acquisition SHA256 and Git-blob records
checks.broad_repository_checks: Not rerun for this isolated prototype; root owns integration/build checks
checks.layout_assertions: C11 and C++14 compile-time: sample size/offsets, snapshot size764/alignment4 and all member offsets

observation_contract.maps: Five exact 16K prefixes, lazy inhibit-cache/read-only mapping, map released before descriptor
observation_contract.success_meaning: Only the bounded observation completed; no initialized hardware, coherent root snapshot, DMA or ownership proof
observation_contract.raw_status_separation: snapshot.result and logged result never changed by OSData allocation/property failures; service start fails separately if either property was not recorded
observation_contract.diagnostic_coherence: Always noncoherent. Power/clock words may be from current or older guards or zero-initialized/unread; no valid bitmap. Only samples below sample_count were successful DART reads. No atomic hardware snapshot.
observation_contract.retention: IOResources retains copied OSData independent of survey instance teardown. No resource publication, notification, removal or retry. Missing bytes are missing evidence.

remaining_gates: Independent source review and pinned SDK/KPI/linked artifact validation
Unmodified pinned HV hook configuration or fresh proof the power words are not shadowed
Actual already-enabled PMGR/PHY/port prerequisite state; otherwise NOT_READY without change
External power/clock owner serialization and absence of concurrent mutation are not enforced by this prototype
First MMIO access can synchronously abort/hang; callback limits do not bound bus instruction latency
Root-owned explicit candidate authorization/recovery; no hardware clearance issued here
Any future real IOMapper requires separate RID/SID ownership, backing lifetime, invalidation/coherency, MSI and fault containment
change_scope: Preserve copied OSData on persistent IOResources under PDDARTSurveyDiagnosticV1 as well as existing instance property
Log allocation/provider/instance preservation independently of unchanged raw observation status
V1 764-byte layout unchanged; new compile-time size/alignment/all-member-offset assertions
Source-shape assertions plus verbatim extracted native publication body tested with host ownership fakes
Document stale/partial/noncoherent words and require actual data, never service/log presence, as evidence
